title: MatcherBody
description: Parsed body of a FIND/READ/SHOW/HIDE statement, discriminated on `dialect`. The dialect is determined by the body's leading characters (`//` xpath, `/` regex, `$` jsonpath, `~` rag, `@` graph, else glob). The regex variant carries pattern/flags split out of the `/pattern/flags` literal; the compiled `RegExp` object on the in-memory AST is a runtime ergonomic only and is not part of the persisted/wire contract.

XPathBody.title: XPathBody
XPathBody.description: XPath 1.0 expression. Validated at parse time via the xpath library.

RegexBody.title: RegexBody
RegexBody.description: JavaScript regex literal `/pattern/flags`. Pattern and flags are split out for direct use. `raw` preserves the literal form for round-tripping.

JsonPathBody.title: JsonPathBody
JsonPathBody.description: JSONPath expression. Validated at parse time via jsonpath-plus.

RagBody.title: RagBody
RagBody.description: Semantic similarity query. Body is `~query text` — natural language after the tilde, no parse step. Resolution happens service-side via the deep-embed channel; top-K narrowing via `<L>` on the host statement.

GraphBody.title: GraphBody
GraphBody.description: Code-graph reference query. Body is `@symbol` (neighborhood — both inbound and outbound edges), `@<symbol` (inbound — who references this), or `@>symbol` (outbound — what this references). Resolution happens service-side via a deep-graph channel; no parse step in grammar.

GlobBody.title: GlobBody
GlobBody.description: Pattern with no dialect prefix; treated as a glob/literal match.
